# EasyList and EasyPrivacy rulesets

`easylist.json` and `easyprivacy.json` are declarativeNetRequest rulesets generated by
`scripts/content-blocking-rules.py` from the EasyList and EasyPrivacy filter lists, at the
`easylist/easylist` commit pinned in `release/content-blocking.json`.

- Source: https://easylist.to/ and https://github.com/easylist/easylist
- Authors: The EasyList authors (https://easylist.to/)
- License: dual licensed under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later
  (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html) or the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0
  Unported license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/), as stated at
  https://easylist.to/pages/licence.html. These generated files are distributed under the same
  terms.
- Changes: only network filters are kept, converted to declarativeNetRequest rules; cosmetic
  filters, regular expressions and filters with options declarativeNetRequest cannot express
  are dropped.

These files are separate data. They are not covered by the MIT License of Circa's own code,
and that license does not apply to them. The extension code that loads them
(`native/OrbitChromium/ContentBlocker/`) remains MIT.
